newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values crumble, corn flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values crumble, corn flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean values fell sharply on Tuesday in response to active farmer selling in the country while corn and wheat values were mostly steady, export sources said.
"There's continued movement in the country," an exporter said. "There's more cash (beans) available than people want."
Offers fell seven cents per bushel for spot March.
Exporters said limit gains Monday in CBOT soybeans triggered some farmer selling and marketings continued to be active despite Tuesday's weaker close.
Export business was said to be quiet.

Exporters said they were not surprised a USDA analyst predicted U.S. soybean exports could fall below 900 million bushels this year. Ample South American supplies and soaring U.S. prices will likely force buyers to look elsewhere, USDA predicted.
